messages.author: 4271370c9274971b
messages.subject: Confidence intervals for power spectra
parts:
Hi all,

I have a group of power spectra that I'd like to display as one mean spectrum with confidence intervals. Is there a seewave function to facilitate this? Or can anyone point me in the right direction?

Thanks

Sean

messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Confidence intervals for power spectra
parts:
Hi Sean,
There is no dedicated function to do this. The idea is to do it by hand (;-)); that is get your series of spectra in a single matrix and then compute the stats you like (mean, sd, CI etc) with apply().
HTH
Jerome
